questions.stem: Redstone Lighting, a large firm has a rough new-product idea for Harborview and shows a written description and images to a group of target customers to gauge their reaction before building anything. Which new-product development stage is this?
questions.explanation: Concept testing presents a product concept, often a description or drawing, to target customers to gauge interest before a physical product is built. Test marketing comes much later and puts the actual product in a limited market, while commercialisation is the full launch. Business analysis examines costs and revenues rather than customer reaction to the idea.
questions.hint: A described idea shown to customers, with no product yet, is concept testing.

options.misconception: assumes a full product is already in selected markets
mistakes customer feedback for a financial projection
confuses an early customer reaction with a full launch
